scope: General precision-aware publication-date design for v0.2 Evidence source identity, motivated by the unresolved Singer 2016 Kindle date representation.

current_contract.problem: The current contract cannot represent a known publication year or month without inventing day-level precision or omitting the Evidence object.

governing_rule: Store only the date precision the evidence actually establishes; never manufacture missing calendar components to satisfy validation.

alternatives.reason: Explicit but changes the type and shape of every existing exact date and creates unnecessary consumer and migration churn.
Preserves the string shape and every exact date value while making reduced precision explicit and machine-checkable.
Creates duplicate temporal authorities, inconsistent fallback semantics, or invented precision.

preferred_contract.date_confidence_reason: Precision and evidential confidence are different concepts. This design solves known reduced precision only and does not introduce a new confidence scoring mechanism.

singer_2016_example.reason: 2016 is strongly supported; the exact day remains insufficiently verified for unqualified source-identity use.

versioning.reason: The repository currently gives v0.2 one schema meaning and authoritative knowledge remains v0.1. A separately reviewed atomic repair can update fixture-only v0.2 semantics before authoritative migration without preserving a superseded compatibility union.

required_future_tests: year value with year precision validates
month value with month precision validates
full date with day precision validates
existing exact date strings remain unchanged
all authoritative v0.1 objects remain unchanged
Singer 2016 can be represented year-only without placing 2016-07-03 in Evidence.date

decision_candidate.recommended_acceptance: Accept the string-plus-explicit-precision design direction for Evidence publication dates: retain date as a string, add required date_precision with year, month, or day, validate the value against the declared precision, keep accessed exact, and represent Singer 2016 as date 2016 with year precision. Treat implementation as a separately reviewed v0.2 schema-repair candidate; this acceptance does not itself authorise schema mutation or acceptance of 2016-07-03 as an exact fact.
does_not_authorise: acceptance of 2016-07-03 as an exact Singer publication fact
ADHD migration or Neurodiversity-to-ADHD semantic disposition
